# Subway Seat for GNOME Terminal

Adds a profile with the palette, cursor, selection and bold colours. Re-running the script updates the same profile in place. Ptyxis, GNOME's newer terminal, is not covered.

[GNOME Terminal](https://help.gnome.org/users/gnome-terminal/stable/) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/gnome-terminal/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.sh`](subway-seat.sh) | anywhere; run once with `sh subway-seat.sh` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.sh`](subway-seat-tunnel.sh) | anywhere; run once with `sh subway-seat-tunnel.sh` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.sh`](subway-seat-enamel.sh) | anywhere; run once with `sh subway-seat-enamel.sh` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in any shell in your GNOME session:

```sh
sh subway-seat.sh   # adds the “Subway Seat” profile; pick it in Preferences
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in any shell in your GNOME session:

```sh
sh subway-seat-tunnel.sh   # adds the “Subway Seat Tunnel” profile; pick it in Preferences
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in any shell in your GNOME session:

```sh
sh subway-seat-enamel.sh   # adds the “Subway Seat Enamel” profile; pick it in Preferences
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
